name: Review Sort / Filter Bar
summary: Responsive review-list toolbar that composes target-owned controls without defining sorting, filtering, or form-entry behavior.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Responsive toolbar region for target-owned review-list controls.

anatomy.name: sortGroup
anatomy.description: Optional structural wrapper for a target-owned ordering or filtering control.

anatomy.name: select
anatomy.description: Optional composed Select; its label, options, enhancement, validation, and disabled state remain canonical Select concerns.

anatomy.name: nativeSelectCompatibility
anatomy.description: Legacy containment hook for an unenhanced native select; no field visuals are owned here.

anatomy.name: writeAction
anatomy.description: Optional composed Button or link for a target-owned review-entry destination or action.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Optional accessible toolbar name when surrounding context does not already identify it.

properties.name: control
properties.description: Optional target-owned Select or other native review-list control; option meaning and list effects are not defined here.

properties.name: writeAction
properties.description: Optional Button or link composition; the target decides whether it navigates, reveals in-page content, or invokes another flow.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Inline toolbar that stacks and stretches composed controls on narrow viewports.

states.name: default
states.description: Structural toolbar state; composed controls own their interaction states.

behavior.name: controlBoundary
behavior.description: The target owns option inventory, ordering or filtering meaning, URL synchronization, result updates, focus retention, and announcements.

behavior.name: actionBoundary
behavior.description: The optional action preserves Button or native-link semantics; Review Toolbar does not decide whether it navigates or opens a form.

accessibility: Use a labelled toolbar or equivalent region when the surrounding context does not identify the controls.
Preserve the composed Select label, native fallback, focus, disabled, and validation semantics.
Preserve Button semantics and use an anchor when the write-review affordance is navigation.
When a target updates the review list in place, preserve focus and announce meaningful result changes outside this layout contract.

web.notes: Canonical CSS owns responsive layout and containment only; composed controls own visual states.

shopify.notes: A future adapter must select provider-backed options and write-review entry behavior.
